terrain.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate an ORIGINAL PRODUCTION TERRAIN TEXTURE ATLAS for the Brazilian chibi 2D RPG Soulmonsters, Parque das Pipas. Reference1 is the previous material atlas: preserve its FOUR-QUADRANT TECHNICAL LAYOUT but improve coherence and calmness. Reference2 is the environment concept: match warm sunny botanical palette. This is NOT a complete map. No props, scenery, perspective, text, grids, borders or framing.
Landscape1536x1024 with EXACT2x2 equal quadrants each768x512 fully filled material. All materials look like one artist painted them for one map with the same warm ambient light. Absolutely uniform density and illumination across each swatch; NO vignette or large patches. Target repeated tiles, edges must look visually continuous; do not accentuate their boundaries.
TOP LEFT lawn: quiet sage/leaf green short grass, low contrast, broad calm near-flat painted ground, very sparse small blade strokes, no flowers, no tufts, no rocks, no checkerboard, no light yellow mottled islands, no dark spots. Similar tone everywhere, restrained detail, lets trees and characters dominate.
TOP RIGHT footpath: pale warm sandy ochre compacted earth, quiet worn ground, tiny subtle irregular brush texture, only a handful of very small embedded pebbles, no dark shadows/no light islands.
BOTTOM LEFT rest plaza: warm ivory limestone paving, medium-sized gently irregular interlocking rounded slabs, subdued thin warm tan seams, no depth, no bevels, no cast shadows, coherent continuous paving pattern.
BOTTOM RIGHT encounter habitat: darker LEAF GREEN dense fine upright blades of tall grass seen from elevated top-down, closely interwoven tufts with no distinct individual clump silhouettes or bare soil. Many uniformly distributed thin leaf strokes, no flowers, no large bushes, no pots. Grass tone stays close to lawn, just darker with readable leaves. Fill entire quadrant edge-to-edge with this habitat texture; no outside silhouette or baked background.
Flat hand-painted crisp 2D cartoon, simplified calm textures, gentle tiny color variation, not photorealistic or pixel noise. NO objects. Four material swatches only. Never make a complete landscape or a collage of isolated terrain islands.

nature.prompt:
Use case illustration-story. Production TRANSPARENT environment sprite atlas for Soulmonsters Brazilian neighborhood park. Use attached reference ONLY for matching exact warm outlined painted cartoon art, sunlight upper LEFT, orthographic three-quarter top-down RPG camera and tree scale. These are botanical VARIANTS of the same park kit, not a new art style.
Landscape1536x1024, strict invisible TWO columns TWO rows. Exactly FOUR isolated complete assets, each comfortably centered in its own quadrant with wide completely transparent gutters. No labels, grid, ground squares or scene. All parts fully within own cell, opaque foliage/wood with genuinely clear alpha0 outside.
TOP LEFT: one complete medium broad green shade tree, asymmetrical dense leafy crown slightly leaning left, clearly connected trunk and roots, warm leaf green foliage with golden highlights. No kite, no flowers, no vines decoration.
TOP RIGHT: one complete alternate slightly taller green tree, two main branching stems joining one trunk at roots, rounded compact canopy, same botanical palette and leaf rendering and same scale. No kite, no flowers.
BOTTOM LEFT: one low rounded connected shrub cluster, calm dark leaf green with gentle gold highlights, dense broad leaves, organic lobed outline. No flowers, no rocks, no pot, no grass square, no visible bare ground. Its visual height is roughly one third of a full tree at same world scale, do not enlarge to fill the quadrant.
BOTTOM RIGHT: one modest low planted flowerbed cluster, green small leaves and a few tiny ivory and pink flowers, organic low wide silhouette, roughly one fifth tree height, same world scale. No planter border, no pot, no rocks, no floor rectangle. Do not enlarge to fill quadrant.
All four share same outline weight, warm ambient lighting, color saturation and brushwork as reference. Clean silhouettes, complete trunks touch crowns, roots join trunks. No detached plant bits. Do NOT include gazebo or paper kites anywhere. No dark shadow halo, no white matte. Very generous transparent space, especially around crowns and roots.
